intro.title: A refuge among
intro.para1: Nestled in the Ome hills, the Hotel San Michele is a family-run hotel that upholds the values of authentic hospitality. Each room has been designed as a private retreat, featuring natural materials, abundant light, and a view that captures the essence of Franciacorta.
intro.para2: The tranquility of the vineyards, breakfast featuring local artisanal products, and the panoramic terrace overlooking Franciacorta: San Michele is the ideal starting point for exploring one of Lombardy’s most beautiful regions.
